Shareholding disclosure and governance norms for substantial shareholders; may interact with takeover code on director appointment.

headline: Pastel Limited files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Bharti Airtel stake
sum: Pastel Limited has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI's Takeover Regulations, signalling a material acquisition of Bharti Airtel shares and triggering mandatory regulatory reporting requirements.
detail: The disclosure by Pastel Limited to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 indicates a substantial acquisition event in Bharti Airtel. Regulation 31(4) requires detailed disclosure of acquirer identity, mode of acquisition, timing, and current shareholding slab. The transaction is subject to SEBI Takeover Code's reverse-flip, standstill and open-offer conditions.
